servicesPage.intro: Arrow Electrical Contractors offers a full range of electrical services for residential and commercial clients in Dallas. Our licensed electricians deliver safe, efficient, and code-compliant solutions tailored to your needs.

services.title: Electrical Panel Upgrades
services.shortDescription: Modernize your electrical panel for safety and capacity.
services.longDescription: Older panels can be a fire hazard and limit your home's electrical capacity. Arrow Electrical provides expert panel upgrades, including breaker replacements and full service upgrades, ensuring your system meets current codes and handles modern demands.
benefits: Increased safety and reduced fire risk

process.title: Inspection
process.description: Our electrician assesses your current panel and load requirements.

process.title: Permitting & Planning
process.description: We handle all permits and design a compliant upgrade plan.

process.title: Installation & Testing
process.description: We install the new panel, test all circuits, and ensure flawless operation.

faqs.question: How do I know if I need a panel upgrade?
faqs.answer: Signs include flickering lights, frequent breaker trips, or if your panel is over 25 years old. We offer free inspections to determine your needs.

faqs.question: How long does a panel upgrade take?
faqs.answer: Most residential upgrades are completed in one day, depending on the complexity.

services.title: Whole-Home Rewiring
services.shortDescription: Replace outdated wiring for safety and peace of mind.
services.longDescription: Homes with old wiring (knob-and-tube, aluminum, or degraded insulation) pose serious risks. Arrow Electrical performs whole-home rewiring with modern materials, bringing your electrical system up to code and ready for today's technology.
benefits: Eliminates fire hazards from deteriorated wiring

process.title: Assessment
process.description: We evaluate your home's existing wiring and create a rewiring plan.

process.title: Preparation
process.description: We protect your belongings and minimize disruption during the process.

process.title: Rewiring & Restoration
process.description: Our team replaces all wiring, installs new outlets and switches, and restores walls with care.

faqs.question: Is rewiring necessary if my house is old?
faqs.answer: If your home has knob-and-tube or aluminum wiring, rewiring is highly recommended for safety and insurance compliance.

faqs.question: Will I need to move out during rewiring?
faqs.answer: In most cases, you can remain in the home. We work room by room to minimize inconvenience.

services.title: Lighting Installation & Design
services.shortDescription: Enhance your space with custom lighting solutions.
services.longDescription: From ambient to accent lighting, Arrow Electrical designs and installs lighting that transforms your home or business. We work with architects and designers to create beautiful, energy-efficient lighting plans that match your vision.
benefits: Customized lighting for any room or outdoor area
Energy savings with LED and smart controls
Enhanced curb appeal and property value

process.title: Consultation
process.description: We discuss your goals, preferences, and budget for the lighting project.

process.title: Design & Selection
process.description: We create a lighting plan and help you choose fixtures and controls.

process.title: Installation & Programming
process.description: Our electricians install fixtures, dimmers, and smart systems, then program them to your liking.

faqs.question: Do you install outdoor landscape lighting?
faqs.answer: Yes, we specialize in low-voltage landscape lighting that highlights your property's best features.

faqs.question: Can you integrate lighting with smart home systems?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We install and configure smart switches, dimmers, and hubs compatible with Alexa, Google Home, and Apple HomeKit.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Services
services.shortDescription: Reliable electrical support for your business.
services.longDescription: Arrow Electrical provides comprehensive commercial electrical services, from new construction to tenant improvements and emergency repairs. We minimize downtime and ensure your business remains powered and code-compliant.

process.title: Needs Analysis
process.description: We review your facility's electrical requirements and usage patterns.

process.title: Proposal & Scheduling
process.description: We provide a detailed quote and schedule work to avoid peak business hours.

process.title: Execution & Follow-Up
process.description: Our team completes the work efficiently, followed by testing and a final walk-through.

faqs.question: Do you offer maintenance contracts?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer customized preventive maintenance plans to keep your electrical systems running reliably.

faqs.question: What types of businesses do you serve?
faqs.answer: We serve offices, retail spaces, restaurants, warehouses, and more. Contact us for a free consultation.

about.headline: Dallas’s Electrical Experts Since 2008
about.mission: To provide safe, reliable, and affordable electrical services that exceed customer expectations, while upholding the highest standards of professionalism and craftsmanship.
story: Arrow Electrical Contractors was founded in 2008 with a simple mission: deliver honest, high-quality electrical work to the Dallas community. What started as a small team of two has grown into a trusted name known for precision and integrity. Our founder, a master electrician with over 20 years of experience, built the company on the belief that every job deserves the same attention to detail, whether it’s a simple outlet repair or a full commercial build-out.

Today, we serve hundreds of homeowners and businesses across Dallas, from historic Lakewood homes to modern Uptown offices. Our team continues to invest in training and technology to stay ahead of industry standards. We’re proud of our 5.0-star reputation and the long-term relationships we’ve built with our clients. At Arrow Electrical, we don’t just wire buildings — we power communities.
